hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Vox's campaign for the November 29 election has intensified around controversial policy pushes for 'remigration' and 'national priority,' stirring sharp political friction across Spain. Tensions escalated following aggressive antifa boycotts and egg-throwing targeting Vox campaign stands in Pamplona and Sabadell, alongside warnings from left-wing opponents about a potential 210-seat PP-Vox right-wing bloc.
hotspots.affect: High emotional volatility is fueled by violent street clashes at campaign stops, existential warnings from political opponents, and aggressive anti-immigration framing.

hotspots.title: RN Headquarters Raided in State Leaks Probe
hotspots.blurb: French judicial authorities and police have expanded their investigation into alleged confidential leaks from the Interior Ministry to Marine Le Pen's Rassemblement National. Following searches of party premises and ministry offices, high-ranking prefect Hugues Moutouh was summoned for questioning over suspicions of aiding RN's effort to penetrate state administrative structures.
hotspots.affect: This story dominates coverage through acute legal jeopardy, state-integrity alarm, and allegations of far-right infiltration into law enforcement.

hotspots.title: AfD Pushes Early Premier Vote in Saxony-Anhalt
hotspots.blurb: Alternative for Germany (AfD) candidate Ulrich Siegmund is aggressively campaigning to force an early vote for Minister-President in Saxony-Anhalt on December 8, attempting to breach the political 'brandmauer' (firewall). The bold maneuver has thrown regional CDU leadership into turmoil, forcing debates over whether coalition partners will walk out of the chamber or risk enabling an AfD executive takeover.
hotspots.affect: Commands intense interest due to high political drama surrounding the potential collapse of the mainstream firewall against the far-right in East Germany.

hotspots.title: Moraes Bars Allied Visits to Imprisoned Bolsonaro
hotspots.blurb: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes continues his aggressive judicial crackdown on the Bolsonaro political family, voting to uphold strict precautionary measures—including passport confiscations and travel restrictions—against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro due to explicit flight risks. The ongoing legal pressure coincides with Jair Bolsonaro's sudden hospitalization for severe abdominal pain and upcoming Supreme Court rulings on coup attempt sentences.
hotspots.affect: Carries deep affective charge driven by systemic persecution narratives among right-wing supporters and heightened legal confrontation between the judiciary and Bolsonarismo.

hotspots.title: Kaczyński Demands Strict Terms for Constitutional Reset
hotspots.blurb: Negotiations between President Karol Nawrocki and Prime Minister Donald Tusk over a proposed 'constitutional reset' for the Constitutional Tribunal (TK) remain locked in a tense standoff. PiS leadership and Pałac Prezydencki maintain uncompromising terms regarding judicial appointments, sparking sharp exchanges during brief official ceremonies and fueling ongoing institutional warfare.
hotspots.affect: Commands persistent attention due to high-stakes institutional gridlock and bitter constitutional rivalry in Polish politics.
